divergences: Primitive 2N-th root psi: impl1 fixes psi=g^6 with g=11 (smallest primitive root); impl2 searches for any element of order 2048 — spec gives only the constraints psi^2048=1, psi^1024=-1, leaving the actual ROM root open
Transform flavor: both chose negacyclic, but spec only marks it 'implied' (cyclic is the explicit fallback) — agreement here is interpretive, not specified
Radix-4 datapath: both model it as two fused radix-2 stages rather than genuine 4-point butterflies; neither verifies the 33%/20% op-count claims because the spec gives no radix-4 butterfly equations

Conflict-free scheme: both verify only that b(i)=(i+(i>>3))%8, o(i)=i>>3 is a storage bijection; neither reproduces the per-cycle 8-BU operand routing / crossbar permutation because the schedule is unspecified
Forward-transform output ordering (natural vs bit-reversed) is assumed by convention; spec states 'no bit-reversal stage' but not the resulting index convention

structural_findings: Both are untimed combinational functional models: the 9-cycle pipelined datapath, the eight parallel lanes, and the crossbar are described but not realized as concurrent/pipelined structure
The headline contribution — radix-4 datapath and its quantified op savings — is collapsed into ordinary radix-2 processing, so the specific architecture the paper describes is not reproduced
The conflict-free scheme is reduced to a static storage bijection; the per-stage operand routing / crossbar permutation that is the paper's Sec. III result is absent
I/O boundary (PCIe edge, DMA, FIFOs) is modeled as plain in-memory coefficient vectors with no protocol or ordering semantics

summary: Reproducibility is moderate: the spec firmly pins the functional core (N=1024, q=12289, 14-bit, Barrett mu/k) and both impls independently rebuild a verified negacyclic NTT with the round-trip identity, but they diverge on the unspecified primitive root and cannot reconstruct the conflict-free schedule, radix-4 butterfly equations, or pipeline timing — the architectural substance is left open. Fidelity is limited by exactly those gaps: parameters match the paper well, but the system's defining innovations (scalable radix-4 with 33%/20% op savings, ~50% operator-sharing, and the per-cycle conflict-free access) are unimplemented or unverifiable, so the impls capture a generic correct NTT engine rather than the specific CFNTT architecture.
guessed: Transform flavor (spec: 'unstated in source, PQC/HE context implies negacyclic') -> negacyclic NTT over Z_q[x]/(x^N+1)

Primitive 2N-th root psi (spec: 'any generator satisfying psi^2048=1, psi^1024=-1') -> psi = g^6 mod q with g the smallest primitive root of 12289 (g=11), so psi=11^6 mod 12289; satisfies the stated constraints

NTT datapath algorithm (not given) -> Longa-Naehrig style: Cooley-Tukey/DIT forward (natural-in, bit-reversed-out) with merged psi twiddles + Gentleman-Sande/DIF inverse (bit-reversed-in, natural-out); pointwise product done in the bit-reversed domain so no explicit bit-reversal stage is needed
Modular multiply realization -> Barrett everywhere (mu=21843, k=28 from spec); symmetric add/sub = conditional single subtract/add of q
Forward-transform output index convention -> array position k holds natural frequency brv(k) (standard DIT result)
Radix-4 path -> NOT functionally implemented; modeled only as stage-fusion of two radix-2 stages; the 33%/20% op-count claims are NOT verified (spec gives them only as properties)
Pipeline latencies (mult 3 / add-sub 1 / Barrett 4 / reg 1 = 9) -> treated as cosmetic; the functional model is combinational (spec marks these 'reproduction defaults')
INTT N^-1 scaling value -> ninv=pow(1024,-1,12289); asserted to equal the spec's 8857
Transform flavor -> negacyclic NTT (psi a primitive 2N=2048-th root, omega=psi^2); spec says only 'implied', not stated
Primitive root psi -> smallest element of multiplicative order 2048 mod 12289 found by search (the paper's actual root/twiddle table is not transcribed)

NTT datapath structure -> canonical Cooley-Tukey forward (DIT, natural-in / bit-reversed-out) + Gentleman-Sande inverse (Longa-Naehrig merged psi-NTT); spec gives no butterfly equations or data ordering
Modular multiply inside butterfly -> Barrett(a*w) using the given mu=21843,k=28 (authoritative); product assumed < q^2 so Barrett input domain is [0,q^2)

Per-cycle conflict-free schedule -> only verified the storage map b(i)=(i+(i>>3))%8, o(i)=i>>3 is a bijection and that any aligned block of 8 consecutive indices spans all 8 banks; the actual cycle-by-cycle 8-BU operand routing is not given
Radix-4 datapath -> assumed to be two fused radix-2 stages producing identical results (the 33%/20% saving claim); not separately implemented as genuine 4-point butterflies
Twiddle-ROM contents/addressing -> assumed psi^brv(k) tables; spec gives neither table contents nor address function
FIFO/PCIe/DMA I/O -> modeled as plain coefficient-vector in/out; no width/handshake/protocol given
Pipeline latencies (9 cyc/lane) -> not modeled; functional model is untimed (spec calls them 'reproduction defaults')
